title: Localized explicit tensor-Hom evaluation is natural on chain inputs
statement: Let X be a scheme and Q its derived localization. Let P,Pprime,L,Lprime,M,Mprime be arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes of module sheaves. Use the fixed functorial K-injective resolution I, inverse localized augmentation v_M, total tensor comparison mu(P,L), and explicit uncurrying U from [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-model], [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison], and [lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-differential]. For chain maps a:Pprime->P, b:Lprime->L, c:M->Mprime and phi:P->HomComplex(L,I(M)) [def-pur-hom-complex], put psi=a;phi;HomComplex(b,I(c)). Then mu(Pprime,Lprime);Q U(psi);v_Mprime = (Qa tensor Qb);mu(P,L);Q U(phi);v_M;Qc. There is no unknown family of functions, no arbitrary derived input, and no K-flatness hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0A90, componentwise evaluation and functoriality; cohomology.tex Tag 08DJ (lemma-internal-hom). Sources read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A90 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DJ.

proof.text: On each summand Pprime^p tensor Lprime^q in total degree n=p+q, use the Hom product projection equation to compute the component of psi as a_p;phi_p projected at q;Hom(b_q,I(c)_n). Apply naturality of the sheaf tensor-Hom equivalence and of the symmetry. The component becomes (a_p tensor b_q);U(phi)_n;I(c)_n. The explicit uncurrying summand equation and coproduct extensionality imply U(psi)=Tot(a tensor b);U(phi);I(c). Differential compatibility makes both maps actual chain maps.

Apply Q to this chain-map equality. Naturality of its lax tensor comparison gives (Qa tensor Qb);mu(P,L)=mu(Pprime,Lprime);Q Tot(a tensor b). Naturality of the functorial resolution augmentation, followed by cancellation of its localized isomorphisms, gives QI(c);v_Mprime=v_M;Qc. Substitute both equalities and reassociate to obtain the claim.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A90 and 08DJ; explicit component evaluation and localization naturality

theorem schemeTensorHomUncurry_localized_evaluation (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (P P' L L' M M' : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a : P' ⟶ P) (b : L' ⟶ L) (c : M ⟶ M')
    (φ : P ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L
      ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M)) :
    letI := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    pullbackTensorModelMap X P' L' ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X P' L' M'
        (a ≫ φ ≫ (Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := X.sheaf))).map
          (X := (op L, (schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M))
          (Y := (op L', (schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M'))
          (b.op, (schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).map c))) ≫
        schemeHomResolutionInverse X M' =
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map a ⊗ₘ DerivedCategory.Q.map b) ≫
        (pullbackTensorModelMap X P L ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X P L M φ) ≫
            schemeHomResolutionInverse X M) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map c
